title: Owe Mora, Pay Mora
description: Something seems to be troubling Goth...

mainQuestExcel.title: Owe Mora, Pay Mora
mainQuestExcel.description: Something seems to be troubling Goth...

dialogs.text: *sigh* I suppose I might have to sort this out myself...
Ack, these old bones will fall apart at this rate...
Is there some urgent matter?
Oh, Traveler? Well, this... I wouldn't call it "an urgent matter," but it is getting out of hand for sure...
As you know, those Fatui have my hotel fully booked.
And as you know, I, as the boss of the Goth Grand Hotel, have to attend to them.
I coordinate food catering, repairs, and a slew of miscellaneous matters besides.
Lately, some rooms have had their furniture damaged, so I've had to contact people to bring the appropriate timber to some carpenters.
Then there's the matter of collecting rent on a few apartments... and the matter of my lad Marvin being nowhere to be found.
*sigh* I wonder how long I can last... Or when that boy will finally grow up...
I'll lend you a hand.
You're willing to help? Ah, that's wonderful! ... *sigh* If only that loud Marvin had as good a head on his shoulders as you. That would've spared me much trouble...
In that case, could I trouble you to fetch some Fir Wood and Birch Wood? I'll need to have them sent to the carpenters soon.
You rest here first.
Have you obtained the timber? I just need one set of Fir Wood and another of Birch Wood.
Thank you so much. These should do. Now to send them off to the carpenter... Oh. Right! I need to collect rent as well...
*sigh* I just wonder if that... As... Astromona, or whatever she was called, will be in this time...
It's Mona Megistus, the Astrologist.
Right! Yes, that was her name... Ugh. It's a bit long, if you ask me.
Mona hasn't paid her rent, you say?
Well, that's just the thing, see? All my other tenants have already paid theirs. She's the only one left.
I came by a few times previously, but she wasn't in.
So please, Traveler, help me go down there and urge her to pay up soon, would you?
As... Astro... Hmm, what was her name again?
Mona, are you home?
Mona, it's rent time!
Huh. Mona really doesn't seem to be home...
That's weird. Isn't she cooped up in that house most of the time? Is she out on some business?
...Or maybe she's unable to come to the door, faint from hunger as she is?
I doubt things are that bad...
Huh. Is that so?
But where should we go to find Mona...
Didn't she say that she's found some way to make money?
The Knights of Favonius Library, I'd say.
The library... Ooh, that's right! The library's a pretty big place. Maybe she's looking for research materials in there!
Well, time to get moving!
Good Hunter. I hear there's salad to be had there.
Good Hunter... Hmm... Right, maybe she's gone there for some salad. Let's go have a look.
Well, that's assuming she has enough Mora on hand to buy salad...
Let's just go to Katheryne directly.
Katheryne, huh? That's a good pick for sure — she knows basically everything, after all!
Well, let's get going!

flow.stepDescription: Look for Mona in the library

dialogs.text: Well, no sign of Mona. Lisa isn't in, either.
Let's go ask that Knight at the door. Maybe he's seen Mona.
Hello. How may I assist?
Excuse me, have you seen a girl who looks something like this...
You describe Mona's distinguishing features to Wyratt...
Oh! I know who you're talking about. It's the girl with the really big hat!
She often comes by to consult some of the texts we keep here. She spends the whole day reading, so she's quite the memorable patron.
That said, she hasn't swung by recently. I doubt you'll find her hereabouts...
Seems we're a little late.
If she does come by, I'll make sure to tell her that you're looking for her.
That's all I can do for you in this case, unfortunately...
No problem. Thank you.
Think nothing of it.
Well, looks like Mona's not in the library. Guess we've got to tell Goth that we couldn't find her...

flow.stepDescription: Go to Good Hunter to look for Mona

dialogs.text: Hi there! Would you like to order anything?
Excuse me, have you seen a girl who looks something like this...
You describe Mona's distinguishing features to Sara...
Oh, you mean Mona, don't you? At one time, she came by every evening to grab some salad — she sometimes even asked me for an extra egg or two.
Guess she's as short of Mora as ever, huh...
She hasn't come once in the past few days, though.
If you're in a hurry to find her, I can pass a message on to her for you the next time she comes by to get salad.
Thanks.
Looks like Mona hasn't been to Good Hunter. Ugh, guess we've got to go tell Goth that we couldn't find her today...
Hello, how may I help you?
Have you seen Mona recently?
Mona? Hmm... No, I can't say I have...
If you're in a hurry to find her, why not post a commission here at the Guild?
Thanks, but we'll look for her ourselves.
Hmm. Katheryne's got no clue where Mona is. Guess it's back to Goth to tell him that we couldn't find her today...
How did it go? Were you able to find that Ast... Well, your friend?
She doesn't seem to be home today.
Well, alright that. She doesn't really owe that much rent. We can put it off for a few days.
Ah, yes. Please take these for your help in the meantime.
